---- MODULE W4Od12m7p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

CAP == 3
MAXV == 5
Workers == {"w1", "w2"}
NONE == -1

VARIABLES inv, ver, snapV, snapC, intent

vars == <<inv, ver, snapV, snapC, intent>>

Intents == {"dep", "wd", "none"}

Init ==
    /\ inv = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ snapV = [w \in Workers |-> NONE]
    /\ snapC = [w \in Workers |-> NONE]
    /\ intent = [w \in Workers |-> "none"]

Read(w) ==
    /\ intent[w] = "none"
    /\ \E i \in {"dep", "wd"} :
        /\ intent' = [intent EXCEPT ![w] = i]
    /\ snapV' = [snapV EXCEPT ![w] = ver]
    /\ snapC' = [snapC EXCEPT ![w] = inv]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inv, ver>>

Commit(w) ==
    /\ intent[w] # "none"
    /\ ver < MAXV
    /\ snapV[w] = ver
    /\ \/ /\ intent[w] = "dep"
          /\ snapC[w] + 1 <= CAP
          /\ inv' = inv + 1
       \/ /\ intent[w] = "wd"
          /\ snapC[w] - 1 >= 0
          /\ inv' = inv - 1
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ intent' = [intent EXCEPT ![w] = "none"]
    /\ snapV' = [snapV EXCEPT ![w] = NONE]
    /\ snapC' = [snapC EXCEPT ![w] = NONE]

Abandon(w) ==
    /\ intent[w] # "none"
    /\ \/ snapV[w] # ver
       \/ /\ intent[w] = "dep" /\ snapC[w] + 1 > CAP
       \/ /\ intent[w] = "wd"  /\ snapC[w] - 1 < 0
    /\ intent' = [intent EXCEPT ![w] = "none"]
    /\ snapV' = [snapV EXCEPT ![w] = NONE]
    /\ snapC' = [snapC EXCEPT ![w] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inv, ver>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ ver >= MAXV
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Quiesce
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Read(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Commit(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Abandon(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ inv \in 0..(2*CAP)
    /\ ver \in 0..MAXV
    /\ snapV \in [Workers -> (0..MAXV) \cup {NONE}]
    /\ snapC \in [Workers -> (0..(2*CAP)) \cup {NONE}]
    /\ intent \in [Workers -> Intents]

CapacityBound ==
    inv <= CAP

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityBound
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker records how many units of blood are stored in a
single refrigerated bank whose capacity is bounded. Several intake/dispatch
workers share one atomic register that holds the current unit count together
with a version stamp. To deposit or withdraw a unit, a worker first reads the
register, taking a private snapshot of both the value and the version, and picks
an intent (deposit one unit or withdraw one unit). It then attempts a
compare-and-swap commit: the commit succeeds only if the register's version
still equals the version the worker snapshotted, and a deposit additionally
succeeds only if it keeps the count within capacity; on success the count is
updated and the version is bumped. A worker may be slow: by the time it tries to
commit, another worker may have already changed the register, so the version no
longer matches. Such a slow worker is not failed -- its compare-and-swap simply
fails, it discards its stale snapshot and becomes idle again so it can re-read and
retry later. A worker also abandons its attempt and returns to idle if the
operation it intended has become infeasible -- a deposit that would overflow
capacity or a withdrawal from an empty bank.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The recorded number of blood units never exceeds the bank's capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od3m3p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Items == {"i1", "i2", "i3"}
Amount == [i1 |-> 1, i2 |-> 2, i3 |-> 3]
MAXT == 3
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES term, leader, record, posted, msgs

vars == <<term, leader, record, posted, msgs>>

SumAmt(S) == LET f[T \in SUBSET Items] ==
                 IF T = {} THEN 0
                 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in T : TRUE
                      IN Amount[x] + f[T \ {x}]
             IN f[S]

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ record = 0
    /\ posted = {}
    /\ msgs = {}

Elect(n) ==
    /\ term < MAXT
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, posted, msgs>>

Propose(i) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ i \notin posted
    /\ ~ \E m \in msgs : m.item = i
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[item |-> i, term |-> term]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, record, posted>>

Apply(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ m.term = term
    /\ m.item \notin posted
    /\ record' = record + Amount[m.item]
    /\ posted' = posted \cup {m.item}
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

Discard(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ \/ m.term # term
       \/ m.item \in posted
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, record, posted>>

Quiesce ==
    /\ posted = Items
    /\ msgs = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E i \in Items : Propose(i)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Apply(m)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : Discard(m)
    \/ Quiesce

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MAXT
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ record \in 0..SumAmt(Items)
    /\ posted \subseteq Items
    /\ msgs \subseteq [item : Items, term : 0..MAXT]

RecordConsistent ==
    record = SumAmt(posted)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT RecordConsistent
nl:
A bank runs an interbank settlement batch as a small replicated service. A set of
settlement nodes elect a leader by term number: any node may start a new election,
which bumps the global term and installs that node as the current leader. The
leader posts settlement updates against one shared record (a running settled
amount). Each distinct settlement item carries a fixed amount, and posting an item
adds its amount to the record exactly once. The leader proposes a posting by
emitting an apply-message stamped with its term; these messages travel over an
unordered network and may be delivered in any order. When an apply-message is
delivered, it is committed to the record only if its term still matches the
current term (the leader that issued it has not been deposed) and the item has not
already been posted. A message that carries a stale term -- issued by a leader that
has since failed over to a newer one -- or that refers to an already-posted item
is simply discarded. When every item has been posted and no messages remain, the
batch is quiescent.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared record always equals the sum of the amounts of exactly the settlement items that have been posted, so no committed posting is ever lost or double-counted.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m5p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3", "v4"}
QUORUM == 3
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES phase, vote, collected, grants, held

vars == <<phase, vote, collected, grants, held>>

Init ==
    /\ phase = [c \in Controllers |-> "idle"]
    /\ vote = [v \in Voters |-> NONE]
    /\ collected = [c \in Controllers |-> {}]
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ held = 0

Request(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "seeking"]
    /\ collected' = [collected EXCEPT ![c] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, grants, held>>

Grant(v, c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "seeking"
    /\ vote[v] = NONE
    /\ ~ \E m \in grants : m.node = v /\ m.ctrl = c
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![v] = c]
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {[node |-> v, ctrl |-> c]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, collected, held>>

Collect(c, m) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "seeking"
    /\ m \in grants
    /\ m.ctrl = c
    /\ collected' = [collected EXCEPT ![c] = collected[c] \cup {m.node}]
    /\ grants' = grants \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, held>>

Enter(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "seeking"
    /\ Cardinality(collected[c]) >= QUORUM
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "holding"]
    /\ held' = held + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, collected, grants>>

Release(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "holding"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ vote' = [v \in Voters |-> IF vote[v] = c THEN NONE ELSE vote[v]]
    /\ collected' = [collected EXCEPT ![c] = {}]
    /\ grants' = {m \in grants : m.ctrl # c}
    /\ held' = held - 1

Abandon(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "seeking"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ vote' = [v \in Voters |-> IF vote[v] = c THEN NONE ELSE vote[v]]
    /\ collected' = [collected EXCEPT ![c] = {}]
    /\ grants' = {m \in grants : m.ctrl # c}
    /\ UNCHANGED held

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Request(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Abandon(c)
    \/ \E v \in Voters, c \in Controllers : Grant(v, c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, m \in grants : Collect(c, m)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Enter(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Release(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in [Controllers -> {"idle", "seeking", "holding"}]
    /\ vote \in [Voters -> Controllers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ collected \in [Controllers -> SUBSET Voters]
    /\ grants \subseteq [node : Voters, ctrl : Controllers]
    /\ held \in -1..2

DoorMutex ==
    held <= 1

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DoorMutex
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network guards one critical resource: the front door, which
must never be held open (unlocked) by two controllers at once. Several controllers
compete for the door, and a set of lock-sensor nodes act as voters. To take the
door, a controller broadcasts a request; each free voter that sees the request
grants its vote to that controller by emitting a grant message and committing its
vote to that controller alone. Grant messages travel over the home mesh and may
arrive in any order, so a controller collects them one at a time as they are
delivered. A controller that cannot gather a quorum -- because the remaining votes are
split among rivals -- may give up, returning to idle and freeing every voter that
backed it. Once a controller has collected a quorum (a majority of the voters) it
enters the holding state and controls the door. When it is done it releases the
door, which returns it to idle, frees every voter that had voted for it, and drops
any of its still-in-flight grant messages so the voters can participate in a later
round.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At no reachable state are two different controllers both holding the door at the same time.

---- MODULE W4Od3m8p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Accts == {"a1", "a2"}
Workers == {"w1", "w2"}
TOTAL == 2
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES bal, coarse, fine, stage, plan

vars == <<bal, coarse, fine, stage, plan>>

Init ==
    /\ bal = [a \in Accts |-> 1]
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = [a \in Accts |-> NONE]
    /\ stage = [w \in Workers |-> "idle"]
    /\ plan = [w \in Workers |-> [from |-> "a1", to |-> "a2"]]

Begin(w, f, t) ==
    /\ stage[w] = "idle"
    /\ f # t
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = w
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![w] = "coarse"]
    /\ plan' = [plan EXCEPT ![w] = [from |-> f, to |-> t]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, fine>>

LockFine(w) ==
    /\ stage[w] = "coarse"
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ fine[plan[w].from] = NONE
    /\ fine[plan[w].to] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [a \in Accts |-> IF a \in {plan[w].from, plan[w].to} THEN w ELSE fine[a]]
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![w] = "fine"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, coarse, plan>>

Transfer(w) ==
    /\ stage[w] = "fine"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![w] = "done"]
    /\ bal' = IF bal[plan[w].from] >= 1
              THEN [bal EXCEPT ![plan[w].from] = @ - 1, ![plan[w].to] = @ + 1]
              ELSE bal
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, plan>>

Release(w) ==
    /\ stage[w] = "done"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ coarse' = IF coarse = w THEN NONE ELSE coarse
    /\ fine' = [a \in Accts |-> IF fine[a] = w THEN NONE ELSE fine[a]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, plan>>

AdminOverride(w) ==
    /\ stage[w] # "idle"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ coarse' = IF coarse = w THEN NONE ELSE coarse
    /\ fine' = [a \in Accts |-> IF fine[a] = w THEN NONE ELSE fine[a]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bal, plan>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers, f \in Accts, t \in Accts : Begin(w, f, t)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : LockFine(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Transfer(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Release(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : AdminOverride(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ bal \in [Accts -> 0..TOTAL]
    /\ coarse \in Workers \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in [Accts -> Workers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ stage \in [Workers -> {"idle", "coarse", "fine", "done"}]
    /\ plan \in [Workers -> [from : Accts, to : Accts]]

Conservation ==
    bal["a1"] + bal["a2"] = TOTAL

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch moves funds between a fixed set of accounts
while the total money in the book must be conserved -- nothing is created or
destroyed. Because concurrent settlement workers touch shared accounts, the batch
uses hierarchical two-level locking: to run a transfer a worker must first take the
coarse book-level lock, and only while holding it may it take the fine per-account
locks on both the source and destination account. With all locks held it performs
the transfer, debiting one unit from the source and crediting one unit to the
destination (if the source has funds; otherwise it completes the round without
moving anything). It then releases every lock it holds. A privileged admin may at
any time override a worker that is holding locks: the admin force-releases that
worker's coarse and fine locks and returns it to idle without moving any money, so
a stuck settlement can be cleared by hand.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The sum of all account balances always equals the batch's initial total, so funds are neither created nor destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m8p1t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Orders == {"o1", "o2"}
Levels == {"L1", "L2"}
Qty == [o1 |-> 1, o2 |-> 2]
LevelOf == [o1 |-> "L1", o2 |-> "L2"]
MAXCAP == 4
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES matched, posted, lockC, lockF, cap, stage

vars == <<matched, posted, lockC, lockF, cap, stage>>

SumQty(S) == LET f[T \in SUBSET Orders] ==
                 IF T = {} THEN 0
                 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in T : TRUE
                      IN Qty[x] + f[T \ {x}]
             IN f[S]

Init ==
    /\ matched = 0
    /\ posted = {}
    /\ lockC = NONE
    /\ lockF = [l \in Levels |-> NONE]
    /\ cap = 3
    /\ stage = [o \in Orders |-> "idle"]

AcquireCoarse(o) ==
    /\ stage[o] = "idle"
    /\ lockC = NONE
    /\ lockC' = o
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![o] = "coarse"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<matched, posted, lockF, cap>>

AcquireFine(o) ==
    /\ stage[o] = "coarse"
    /\ lockC = o
    /\ lockF[LevelOf[o]] = NONE
    /\ lockF' = [lockF EXCEPT ![LevelOf[o]] = o]
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![o] = "fine"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<matched, posted, lockC, cap>>

Commit(o) ==
    /\ stage[o] = "fine"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![o] = "committed"]
    /\ IF o \notin posted /\ matched + Qty[o] <= cap
       THEN /\ matched' = matched + Qty[o]
            /\ posted' = posted \cup {o}
       ELSE /\ matched' = matched
            /\ posted' = posted
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockC, lockF, cap>>

Release(o) ==
    /\ stage[o] = "committed"
    /\ stage' = [stage EXCEPT ![o] = "idle"]
    /\ lockC' = IF lockC = o THEN NONE ELSE lockC
    /\ lockF' = [l \in Levels |-> IF lockF[l] = o THEN NONE ELSE lockF[l]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<matched, posted, cap>>

ChangeCap ==
    /\ \E c \in matched..MAXCAP : cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<matched, posted, lockC, lockF, stage>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Orders : AcquireCoarse(o)
    \/ \E o \in Orders : AcquireFine(o)
    \/ \E o \in Orders : Commit(o)
    \/ \E o \in Orders : Release(o)
    \/ ChangeCap

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ matched \in 0..MAXCAP
    /\ posted \subseteq Orders
    /\ lockC \in Orders \cup {NONE}
    /\ lockF \in [Levels -> Orders \cup {NONE}]
    /\ cap \in 0..MAXCAP
    /\ stage \in [Orders -> {"idle", "coarse", "fine", "committed"}]

NoLostUpdate ==
    matched = SumQty(posted)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A stock-exchange opening auction accumulates matched share quantity into one
shared record as orders are posted. Posting is protected by hierarchical locks:
an order-processing job must first take the coarse book-level lock, and only then
the fine lock on the specific price level it targets. Holding both locks, the job
commits its order -- if the running matched total plus the order's quantity still
fits within the current book capacity, the quantity is added to the shared record
and the order is marked posted; otherwise the round completes without posting.
The job then releases all its locks. The book capacity is not fixed: an exchange
operator may change it at runtime, but never below the quantity already matched,
so a capacity change can never orphan an already-recorded match.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared matched-quantity record always equals the sum of the quantities of exactly the orders recorded as posted, so no posted quantity is ever lost or double-counted.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m2p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Instances == {"I1", "I2"}
Drones == {"p1", "p2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES phase, vote, claimed, fired

vars == <<phase, vote, claimed, fired>>

Init ==
    /\ phase = [i \in Instances |-> "idle"]
    /\ vote = [i \in Instances |-> [p \in Drones |-> "none"]]
    /\ claimed = NONE
    /\ fired = 0

Start(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "voting"]
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![i] = [p \in Drones |-> "none"]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claimed, fired>>

Cast(i, p, v) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ vote[i][p] = "none"
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![i][p] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, claimed, fired>>

Commit(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ \A p \in Drones : vote[i][p] = "yes"
    /\ claimed = NONE
    /\ claimed' = i
    /\ fired' = fired + 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED vote

Abort(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ \/ \E p \in Drones : vote[i][p] = "no"
       \/ (claimed # NONE /\ \A p \in Drones : vote[i][p] = "yes")
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, claimed, fired>>

Reset(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![i] = [p \in Drones |-> "none"]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<claimed, fired>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Start(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, p \in Drones, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Cast(i, p, v)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Abort(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Reset(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in [Instances -> {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}]
    /\ vote \in [Instances -> [Drones -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]]
    /\ claimed \in Instances \cup {NONE}
    /\ fired \in 0..2

FireOnce ==
    /\ fired <= 1
    /\ (fired = 1) => (claimed # NONE)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FireOnce
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm can trigger one irreversible action over a
target zone: igniting a controlled backfire. Two independent coordinating
instances run in parallel and share a single ignition pool -- physically the
backfire can be lit only once. Each instance runs its own two-phase commit across
its participant drones: it starts a round, each drone votes yes or no, and the
instance may commit only if every drone voted yes AND the shared ignition claim is
still free. Committing claims the ignition pool for that instance and performs the
one irreversible ignition. If any drone votes no, or the ignition pool has already
been claimed by the other instance, the round aborts. After a committed or aborted
round an instance resets back to idle and may run another round, but the ignition
claim, once taken, is never released.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The irreversible ignition is performed at most once, and only by an instance that has claimed the shared ignition pool.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od1m1p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
Flights == {"f1", "f2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
NextC == [c1 |-> "c2", c2 |-> "c3", c3 |-> "c1"]
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES token, crashed, requested, slotOf

vars == <<token, crashed, requested, slotOf>>

Alive(y) == y \notin crashed
NAS(x) == IF Alive(NextC[x]) THEN NextC[x] ELSE NextC[NextC[x]]
Occupied(s) == \E g \in Flights : slotOf[g] = s

Init ==
    /\ token = "c1"
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ requested = Flights
    /\ slotOf = [f \in Flights |-> NONE]

Allocate(c, f, s) ==
    /\ token = c
    /\ Alive(c)
    /\ f \in requested
    /\ slotOf[f] = NONE
    /\ ~ Occupied(s)
    /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![f] = s]
    /\ requested' = requested \ {f}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, crashed>>

PassToken(c) ==
    /\ token = c
    /\ Alive(c)
    /\ token' = NAS(c)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, requested, slotOf>>

ReclaimToken(c) ==
    /\ ~ Alive(token)
    /\ c = NAS(token)
    /\ token' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, requested, slotOf>>

Crash(c) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, requested, slotOf>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, f \in Flights, s \in Slots : Allocate(c, f, s)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : PassToken(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : ReclaimToken(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Controllers
    /\ crashed \subseteq Controllers
    /\ requested \subseteq Flights
    /\ slotOf \in [Flights -> Slots \cup {NONE}]

NoSharedSlot ==
    \A f1, f2 \in Flights :
        (f1 # f2 /\ slotOf[f1] # NONE /\ slotOf[f2] # NONE)
            => slotOf[f1] # slotOf[f2]

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoSharedSlot
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator lets a ring of tower controllers assign runway
slots to inbound flights. Exclusive authority circulates as a single token: only
the controller currently holding the token may allocate a slot, and it passes the
token to the next live controller in the ring when done. A flight that has
requested a runway may be assigned a free slot by the token holder; a slot that is
already occupied by some flight is never handed to another. One controller may
crash silently at any time (at most one), simply ceasing to participate. To keep
the ring alive, if the token is held by a controller that has crashed, the nearest
live successor in the ring reclaims the token so allocation can continue. When the
token holder is live it may instead pass the token forward to its nearest live
successor.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two distinct flights are ever assigned the same runway slot.

---- MODULE W4Od8m7p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Courses == {"cs1", "cs2"}
Students == {"u1", "u2", "u3"}
Cap == [cs1 |-> 1, cs2 |-> 2]
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES enrolled, ver, snap, target

vars == <<enrolled, ver, snap, target>>

Init ==
    /\ enrolled = [c \in Courses |-> {}]
    /\ ver = [c \in Courses |-> 0]
    /\ snap = [u \in Students |-> 0]
    /\ target = [u \in Students |-> NONE]

A crane may begin acting on its assigned bay only while the epoch it recorded still

numbered epochs, and a reconfiguration -- taken only between actions -- bumps the
epoch, making any assignment recorded under an older epoch stale so its crane can no
longer begin acting. A stale crane must be unassigned or re-authorized before it can
act again. A privileged yard admin may override the epoch check, re-authorizing a
crane's existing assignment to the current epoch so it may act again. A crane may
also be unassigned, which clears its assignment and any action in progress.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A crane has an action in progress on a bay only if that bay is its current assignment and its recorded authorization epoch equals the current yard epoch, so no unauthorized or stale crane ever acts.
